_why: The provenance of guardrail version 2, captured before Change A deletes it. `AWS::Bedrock::GuardrailVersion` carries no UpdateReplacePolicy and both its properties are create-only, so the description change that publishes v3 REPLACES the resource and CloudFormation's cleanup deletes v2. After that, `get_guardrail(guardrailVersion='2')` does not resolve and `verify_guardrail_pin.py --policy-digest` can never produce this number again. SPEC/04 defines `guardrail_policy_sha256` as what the version referred to, fetched back from the deployed guardrail - so without this file, `m04-adversarial` and every other v2-recorded score would name a version nothing can re-derive, in an append-only history that cannot be corrected later. Found by the Platform Engineering seat during the Change A review, by reading the template rather than the diff.
